tools.name: search_servers
tools.description: Search the MCP Harbor directory of MCP servers, clients and SDKs by keyword, optionally filtered by category or by listings that publish an HTTPS remote URL. Returns the best matches ranked by relevance and GitHub stars.

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: Get the full MCP Harbor listing for one server or tool by its slug (as returned by search_servers).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the category slugs used on MCP Harbor, with their display names and listing counts.

tools.name: recent_servers
tools.description: List recently updated MCP servers, optionally filtered by category or by listings that publish an HTTPS remote URL.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the MCP Harbor directory of MCP servers, clients and SDKs by keyword, optionally filtered by category. Returns the best matches ranked by relevance and GitHub stars. Alias of search_servers.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get the full MCP Harbor listing for one tool by its slug (as returned by search_tools). Alias of get_server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_servers, recent_servers · Public sink: search_servers, recent_servers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_servers, recent_servers · Public sink: search_servers, recent_servers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
